title: burn2scar: code that builds the burn2scar data set
description: Code that builds the burn2scar data set of Sentinel-2 Level-1C tiles and burn-scar segmentation masks for EFFIS fires in Italy, Spain, France and Greece (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23986827): fire selection from EFFIS, scene search and download through Sentinel Hub, cloud and shadow masks with OmniCloudMask, burn labels, the index and splits, the label review, the baselines and the release.
